Why Covenant Conversations?

Healing Bridges,
Building Honour

Christianity cannot fully understand itself without the covenantal story of Israel. This platform creates space to study, heal, and celebrate the rich heritage of the global Church.

  • ✦ Study the Jewish roots of Christian faith
  • ✦ Heal misunderstandings and build bridges of honour
  • ✦ Celebrate cultural and artistic expressions
